name: Syed Nafiz Reja Hasib
identity: Computational mechanics of materials and structures: constitutive modelling, finite-element analysis, form-finding and seismic design — spanning self-centring hybrid systems and thin concrete shells with embodied carbon as a coupled design variable.
bio: I work on computational mechanics of materials and structures: constitutive modelling, finite-element analysis, form-finding and seismic design. Thin concrete shells and self-centring NiTi systems are the test cases, and embodied carbon is the design variable that joins them.
currently: Applying for funded MSc and PhD positions starting September 2027.
